questions.question: Which of these is used as a default specifier for a member of the class if no access specifier is used for it?
questions.explanation: By definition if a class has no access specifiers, it defaults to private accessibility.

questions.question: Which of these access specifiers must be used for main() method?
questions.explanation: By default main() is declared private if no other access specifier is used for it.
